tools.name: find_providers
tools.description: Find a venue in the Aurinia network. Venue types currently bookable: doctor, hostel. Optional: query (e.g. 'vertebrologist'), city, type. Returns a providers array; use a provider_id from it for get_availability / book.

tools.name: get_provider_info
tools.description: Details for one venue by provider_id: id, type (doctor/hostel), name, city, address. Read-only, no auth. Use it to confirm a venue before get_availability / book.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Availability and price at a venue. provider_id is required. Parameter names are venue-specific: doctor — date (YYYY-MM-DD); hostel — check_in, check_out, guests (with underscores: check_in/check_out, not 'checkin'/'checkout'; guests is an integer). tools.name: list_current_bookings
tools.description: The user's current/upcoming bookings at a network venue (by date, nearest first). Each has a status field (e.g. booked/confirmed/cancelled) — distinguish active vs cancelled. provider_id optional (without it — the first venue). Requires authorization.

tools.name: list_past_bookings
tools.description: The user's past bookings at a network venue (by date, most recent first). Each has a status field. provider_id optional; limit (default 20)/offset for pagination. Requires authorization.
